section: Perspectives in Education · Ch — Child Protection Laws
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: The Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Amendment Act, 2016, completely prohibits the employment of children below what age in ANY occupation or process?
explanation: The 2016 Amendment prohibits employment of children below 14 years in any occupation, aligning with the RTE Act's free-and-compulsory-education age range (6-14 years); adolescents (14-18) may work only in specified non-hazardous occupations, and are barred entirely from hazardous ones.
